name: tapeira
description: TAPeira - uma aventura sob a montanha

scripts.prepare:web: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/prepare-animation-sprites.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/prepare-web.ps1 && esbuild scripts/android-save-entry.js --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=www/script/android-save.bundle.js
scripts.android:init: npm run prepare:web && cap add android && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/generate-android-icons.ps1
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare:web && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/generate-android-icons.ps1 && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
